svg.title: FDM Newell Cell-Averaged Convolution, Hermitian cuFFT, Multilayer Stacking, and Periodic Images
svg.desc: Two-panel diagram of FDM demagnetization: (a) Newell 27-point cell-averaged tensor, 2N zero-padded real-space buffer layout, and exact Hermitian half-spectrum D2Z/Z2D (FP64) and R2C/C2R (FP32) cuFFT contraction; (b) Lepadatu (2019) vacuum-skipping multilayer z-stack convolution with volume-adjoint transfers (P, P*) contrasted with 2D periodic image tiling and exact Newell uniform-mode convergence N_zz(I) -> 1 and N_xx(I) -> 0.

svg.text: • Padding F ≥ nsrc + ndst − 1 prevents wraparound
• Crop [0 .. N−1] after iFFT gives linear conv.
• Near (< 40 cells): exact Newell · Far: dipole
